_about: Seed: Tamil Nadu / South Indian foods, synonyms and household units for the PCOS tracker.
Sources (values are APPROXIMATE COMPOSITES and fully editable):
* IFCT 2017 - Indian Food Composition Tables, Longvah T. et al., National Institute of Nutrition (ICMR), Hyderabad.
* NIN "Nutritive Value of Indian Foods" (Gopalan C. et al., revised editions) for recipe-level composites.
* USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy / Foundation Foods) for plain ingredients (source = 'usda').
* Published glycaemic-index tables (Atkinson et al., International Tables of GI; Indian GI studies) for gi_band.
Composite dishes (source = 'ifct') are estimated from standard home recipes using the above ingredient data;
actual values vary with recipe, oil and portion. Nutrients are per 100 g (per 100 ml when is_liquid).
veg_fraction = share by weight that is vegetables / greens / legumes (used by the meal balance score).
gi_band: low <= 55, medium 56-69, high >= 70 (approximate; 'medium' used when evidence is mixed).
Idempotent: every insert uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; safe to run repeatedly after the migrations.
